DESIGN PROPOSAL — developed design, buildable; confirm by survey &
PROPOSAL C — TIMBER GARDEN ROOM & OUTDOOR KITCHEN
Glulam garden room with a glass roof for dining, plus an open-air outdoor kitchen along the house wall and tumbled travertine paving.
AXONOMETRIC FROM SOUTH-EAST (east wall cut away at 1.0 m) — NTS

Warm timber structure with a 5° glass roof keeps the doors and hall bright while giving all-weather dining for 8. Cooking happens in the open air beside it: a 4 m built-in kitchen with grill, sink and fridge along the east wall, with services next to the
• GL24h larch glulam, 6 rafters @ 862, front beam on 2 posts (no post mid-span).
• 8+8 laminated solar-control glass, optional motorised shade.
• Outdoor kitchen: grill outside the roof, sink & fridge, sintered-stone top.
• Tumbled travertine in French pattern; planter & jasmine retained.
